name: SaveStatus
description: The reserved line itself. Render it whatever the setting's state, and put `SaveStatusSaved` or `SaveStatusError` inside.

name: SaveStatusError
description: What failed, in place of `SaveStatusSaved`. It is an alert, announced when it appears, and stays until the next change.

name: SaveStatusSaved
description: The polite live region that says the change is stored. Keep it mounted, empty, while nothing has happened, so a screen reader announces the words when they arrive; the check shows only with them.
